releases.notes:
First release of Patina & Chime, for **Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric**.

## Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) 0.20.1 or newer for Minecraft 26.2. The game needs Java 25.
2. Put [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 26.2 and `patina-and-chime-0.1.0+26.2.jar` (below) in your `mods` folder.

Your client and any server you join both need the mod. This version won't load on 26.3.

## What's in it

- **Copper hoppers:** slower than iron, with a different job at each oxidation stage. Wax one to keep its job.
- **Verdigris:** scrape it off old copper, then use it to age other copper.
- **Tuning fork:** strike it to find budding amethyst within 32 blocks.
- **Amethyst at the enchanting table:** shards cost double what lapis does, and show every enchantment in an offer.
- **Music grows crystals:** a jukebox or note block speeds up budding amethyst nearby.
- **Amethyst note block:** put a note block on a Block of Amethyst.

## Worth a listen

The automated tests can't judge how things sound, so the amethyst note block and the tuning fork haven't been checked by ear yet. If something sounds off, or breaks, please [open an issue](https://github.com/gr8monk3ys/patina-and-chime/issues).
